brief.headline: Goldman Upgrades India to Overweight; Anthropic Prices Landmark $83/Share IPO
brief.summary: Indian equities face a muted start following Wednesday's losses in the Nifty 50 to 25227.95, even as Goldman Sachs upgraded India to overweight with a Dec.'27 target of 28,500. Global markets weigh hawkish Fed minutes alongside Anthropic's record $107.3 billion IPO and Nvidia's executive turmoil. Brent crude plunged 4.57% to 88.88, offering macro relief to domestic importers.

takeaways.text: Goldman Sachs upgraded India to overweight with a Dec.'27 Nifty target of 28,500, noting balanced risks after market de-rating.
Capital market stocks like Angel One and BSE dropped up to 3% as SEBI considers imposing limits on Margin Trading Facility leverage.
October Fed minutes showed nearly all officials expect interest rate hikes in the coming months to curb inflation towards the 2% target.
Anthropic priced its record-breaking IPO at $83 per share, raising $107.3 billion across its public listing and private placement.
Nvidia board confirmed Jensen Huang will not return as CEO, accepting his resignation despite Silicon Valley pressure and strong Q3 revenue beat.

sections.india: Domestic benchmark Nifty 50 closed at 25227.95 while Sensex fell to 82031.81 amid weak breadth. Goldman Sachs upgraded Indian equities to overweight, setting a Dec.'27 Nifty target of 28,500. Brokerage stocks remain in focus after falling up to 3% on reports of prospective SEBI curbs on Margin Trading Facility leverage. Meanwhile, India imposed a 162.5% duty on bulk Scotch imports amid a trade pact standoff with the UK.
sections.world: Wall Street ended mixed as S&P 500 slipped 0.23% to 7323.63 while Nasdaq rose 0.42% to 24429.88. Minutes from the Fed's October meeting showed nearly all officials expect further interest rate hikes, with Fed Governor Waller advocating a half-point move. Global leaders including Donald Trump, Xi Jinping, and Vladimir Putin are meeting in Shenzhen for a historic trilateral summit.
sections.tech: Anthropic made history by raising $107.3 billion in an upsized IPO and private placement at $83 per share. Nvidia faced ongoing leadership scrutiny as its board unanimously declined to reinstate former CEO Jensen Huang despite Q3 revenue more than doubling year-on-year. In domestic startup developments, Humyn Labs raised $47 million to provide robotics data, and Soket AI secured $4 million from Bajaj Finserv.

This valuation of around $1.5 trillion marks a major milestone in the tech industry. With $81 billion expected from the offering, this would break SpaceX's record. stories.title: Goldman Sachs upgrades India to overweight; Dec.'27 Nifty target at 28,500
stories.summary: As regards the Indian markets, risks look more balanced today versus the 2024 peak, Goldman Sachs said, as MSCI India has de-rated substantially across most parameters.

stories.title: Govt to charge bulk Scotch imports 162.5% duty and tax amid UK pact standoff
stories.summary: India has implemented a hefty 162.5% duty on bulk Scotch imports, surpassing previously established tariffs. This action follows a trade agreement with the UK that aimed to reduce Scotch tariffs to 75%. Investigators claim that Scotch imports are being misclassified, resulting in higher taxes on these goods. Major companies like Pernod Ricard and Diageo are facing disruptions due to blocked shipments at ports.
stories.ai_summary: India implemented a 162.5% tax and duty on bulk Scotch imports following a standoff in trade talks with the UK. The rate exceeds previously established tariffs.
stories.why_it_matters: Negative for importers and distributors of UK spirits; neutral to positive for domestic liquor makers.

stories.title: Hindustan Copper shares fall 3% as copper prices hit 5-month low
stories.summary: Helped by higher sales volume and metal prices, Hindustan Copper posted an 182 per cent year-on-year (YoY) rise in the second quarter (Q2 FY27) consolidated net profit to ₹518.13 crore.
stories.ai_summary: Hindustan Copper shares fell 3% as global copper prices touched a 5-month low, despite the company reporting Q2 FY27 net profit of ₹518.13 crore. Consolidated net profit rose 182 per cent YoY.

stories.title: RBI warns Yes Bank AT1 bond ruling could weaken future bank rescue framework
stories.summary: The case relates to Yes Bank's rescue in 2020, when authorities wrote off Rs 8,415 crore worth of additional Tier-1 (AT1) bonds. These securities are designed to absorb losses when banks face financial distress.
stories.ai_summary: The RBI warned that a court ruling on Yes Bank's write-off of Rs 8,415 crore in AT1 bonds could weaken future bank resolution mechanisms. The dispute stems from the bank's 2020 rescue package.

stories.title: Angel One, 5paisa, BSE and other capital market stocks slide up to 3% as SEBI weighs MTF curbs; Is the MTF party over?

Proposed restrictions could apply when margin-funded holdings reach a set share of a company’s free float.

stories.title: Relief for Chanda Kochhar as HC quashes ICICI Bank's nod to prosecute ex-CEO in 'loan fraud' case
stories.summary: The Bombay High Court quashed the ICICI Bank's sanction for prosecuting Chanda Kochhar in an alleged fraud case. The court found that the authority granting the sanction did not apply proper judgment to the circumstances. Chanda Kochhar was arrested in December 2022 and received interim bail in January 2023. The case involved a loan of Rs 3,250 crore given to Videocon Group during her tenure.
stories.ai_summary: The Bombay High Court quashed ICICI Bank's sanction to prosecute former CEO Chanda Kochhar in an alleged fraud case due to lack of proper application of judgment.
